topic: Chemical Engineers in the Pharmaceutical Industry
title: Chemical Engineers in the Pharmaceutical Industry
session_title: Chemical Engineers in the Pharmaceutical Industry
abstract: This session is designed to introduce students to the roles chemical engineers play in pharmaceutical discovery, development, and manufacturing. It will feature a brief presentation on the pharma industry followed by Q&A with the panelists. Students are encouraged to bring their questions!
